build_mae_module: build a MAE module with a VisionTransformer encoder and decoder for self-supervised tactile learning
create_random_masking: create random patch masking for a batch of image sequences with a configurable mask ratio
run_forward_encoder: run the encoder forward pass on masked image patches to extract latent representations
compute_mae_loss: compute the masked autoencoder reconstruction loss using normalized pixel-wise MSE on removed patches
configure_optimizers: configure the optimizer with weight decay groups and optional LR and WD schedulers for training
